meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话的上下文和洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在多次对话中保持记忆
copy.tagline_en: Enable agents to remember context and insights across conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to retain memory across turns

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在每次回答前自动回忆之前的对话内容，并在回答后存储新的信息。记忆会保存在容器中，重启后仍然存在。
howto.when: 当使用 Claude Code 模式（--target claude-code）且代理组配置为 Claude 提供商时，每次容器启动和每次对话轮次都会触发。

say.text: 你还记得我们上次讨论的项目计划吗？
say.note: Claude 会从记忆中调取之前对话的相关内容。

say.text: 帮我记住这个配置参数：timeout=30。
say.note: Claude 会在回答后存储这条信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically recalls previous conversation context before each response and stores new insights after each turn. Memory persists across container restarts.
howto.when_en: Triggered on every container start and after each conversation turn when using Claude Code mode (--target claude-code) with the Claude provider.

say_en.text: Do you remember the project plan we discussed last time?
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve relevant context from memory.
Claude will store this information after responding.
